title: Claim Decision from Meridian Health Plans
urgency_reason: The claim was denied and the member may be responsible for the billed amount if the appeal is not successful.
summary: This document is a denial notice from Meridian Health Plans stating that an MRI for a lumbar spine, billed at $2,140, was not approved because conservative treatment must be documented before advanced imaging is allowed. The member has 180 days from the decision date to appeal the denial, and if the appeal is denied, they will be responsible for the cost.
eli5: The insurance company said no to paying for a back MRI because they want proof that other treatments didn't work first, and you have to ask them again within 180 days or you'll have to pay the $2,140 yourself.

key_facts.label: Reason for denial
key_facts.value: The service was determined to be not medically necessary under plan guideline MCG-28. Conservative treatment (physical therapy for a minimum of 6 weeks) must be documented before advanced imaging is approved.

deadlines.consequence: If the denial is upheld, the billed amount becomes your responsibility.

red_flags.why: The denial may be incorrect if conservative treatment was not feasible or documented, and the member may be unfairly burdened with a large bill.

signals: Official letterhead and verifiable reference numbers
Specific reason for denial based on plan guidelines

checklist.step: Review the denial reason and your medical records
checklist.detail: Ensure conservative treatment was documented or explain why it was not appropriate.
Collect any notes, letters, or test results from your doctor that support the need for the MRI.
Send the appeal to the address provided: PO Box 7701, Meridian, ST, before 03/07/2027.
Call or email to confirm receipt of the appeal and ask about the status.

raw_text:
MERIDIAN HEALTH PLANS
EXPLANATION OF BENEFITS — CLAIM DECISION
Member: J. DOE    Member ID: MH-220481
Claim: CL-990412    Decision date: 09/08/2026

Claim status: DENIED
Service: MRI, lumbar spine (CPT 72148) ordered by Dr. Patel on 08/20/2026. Amount billed: $2,140.00.
Reason for denial (code CO-97): The service was determined to be not medically necessary under plan guideline MCG-28. Conservative treatment (physical therapy for a minimum of 6 weeks) must be documented before advanced imaging is approved.
You may appeal this decision. A written appeal with supporting medical records must be submitted within 180 days of this notice (by 03/07/2027). Your provider may appeal on your behalf.
If the denial is upheld, the billed amount becomes your responsibility. Continued PT visits are covered at a $35 copay per session.

CLAIM DENIED
Appeals: PO Box 7701, Meridian, ST • Fax 555-0199
